notes: The second colon has no conjunction morpheme, so Neither rests on the present negative under rule 35's sentence that the same word may rest on a present negative in one line and a gapped waw in the next; it is not added.
The head of evil doers is a live choice; rule 31's subtraction leaves the lexeme in evil, since the ASV never writes doers alone for this participle.
The first assimilated article is unrepresented and the second takes the written the, following what the ASV writes in each phrase.
